finishStory.markedParagraph: Moses and Aaron spoke to [PHARAOH]. They said the [LORD] wanted him to let the Israelites go, but he refused. Pharaoh made God’s people work [HARDER] by making them gather their own [STRAW] for bricks. Moses shared God’s promise to rescue them, but they had lost [HOPE]. God told Moses He would do mighty [MIRACLES] so Egypt would know who He is. When Aaron threw down his [STAFF], God turned it into a [SNAKE]. Pharaoh’s magicians did the same [TRICK], but Aaron’s snake swallowed their snakes. Then Aaron struck the [RIVER], and God turned its water into [BLOOD]. Pharaoh still refused to let God’s people [GO].

reviewFlags.text: The original ESV excerpt of Psalm 100:3a differs from the proposed BSB excerpt. Confirm the BSB selection, punctuation and excerpt end in Review Studio; Scripture-rights approval is separate.
Review the twelve suggested incorrect choices across six Multiple Choice questions.
Approve the six suggested false statements. Confirm their wording is clearly false without tricky assumptions.

The original lesson discusses Egyptian magic, possible demons, slavery, and God’s punishment. The cause of the magicians’ tricks is explicitly uncertain in the lesson and is not asserted as fact in prepared activities.
Review the six deliberate mistakes and corrections for clarity and reading level.
Odd Words uses Dove, Harp, Sling and Lion; Checkboxes uses Trumpet, Lamb, Olives and Tent. Check that both distinct groups are clearly unrelated to OT28.
Review four short Small drawing scenes and six full-sentence Large captions (drawStory reuses storyOrder).
Review the child-friendly Story Order, Finish the Story, and phrase activities against the seven preserved original Story Notes.
The original Important Idea text uses font-dependent lowercase lettering. It is editorially normalized to “Know that the Lord is God.”, capitalizing God as requested.
Run all 27 actual activity preflight checks plus puzzle/grid generators and all three numbered presets; no live generator or preset run is claimed.
All nine crossword clues are prepared but a successful playable grid has not been proven.
OT28 includes only the Nile turning to blood. Do not populate the other nine plagues from the later lessons.
Preserve all original questions, including repetitive and context-dependent prompts. The prepared Multiple Choice list is a separate short selection.
